Definition: Unique tile identifier, also the image file name (images/<ID>.png).

Road centrelines of the tile (OpenStreetMap highways) as a WKT MULTILINESTRING in tile pixel coordinates: x = column, y = row, origin at the top-left corner, both from 0 to the tile size (256 here), lines clipped to the tile. MULTILINESTRING EMPTY when the tile has no mapped road.
Ground size of one pixel in metres (0.25 to 0.30 in this data); use it to convert pixels to metres.
